subject.title: WhatsApp inbound messages not received in k3s nested container (outbound works)

question: Should this no-upsert external inbound tracker remain the canonical bug, be consolidated under active liveness verification, or be narrowed to provider-side backfill/gap-warning work?
rationale: Current code shows the recovery gap, but the durable product choice depends on live WhatsApp behavior, privacy/read-receipt tradeoffs, and how maintainers want to split liveness versus backfill ownership.

options.title: Unify Recovery Design
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle one WhatsApp recovery design that coordinates active liveness, backfill, and gap-warning behavior across the related trackers.

options.title: Consolidate Into Liveness
options.body: Close this issue as duplicate only after moving the k3s and Docker Compose no-upsert evidence to the active-liveness tracker.

options.title: Accept Append-Only Scope
options.body: Declare current bounded append catch-up sufficient, document that no-event recovery is unsupported, and close the related remaining reports by maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Unify Recovery Design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle one WhatsApp recovery design that coordinates active liveness, backfill, and gap-warning behavior across the related trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete co-authored the current partial fix and is the strongest recent maintainer-visible follow-up owner for the remaining provider-side recovery decision.
